title: Publications | Karakochuk
abstract: The document contains a systematic review and meta-analysis titled "The effects of oral ferrous bisglycinate supplementation on hemoglobin and ferritin concentrations in adults and children: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials" by Fischer JAJ, Cherian AM, Bone JN, and Karakochuk CD. This publication is listed as item 62 in the provided document and was published in *Nutrition Reviews* in 2023, with a volume of 81 and an issue of 8, on pages 904-920. The DOI for this publication is 10.1093/nutrit/nuac106.
